intro_text:
Welcome. In this study you will:
1. Answer a few short questions.
2. Choose one video you'd like to watch from our streaming catalogue, and watch it to the end. It includes one short ad.
3. Answer some questions about your experience.

It takes about 17 minutes, in one sitting. Please use a computer with the sound on, and keep this tab open until you finish.

_notes.video_sources: All active titles are self-hosted: full-length files at /static/content/<id>.mp4 (run python scripts/download_all.py to populate) and trimmed copies at /static/content_short/<id>.mp4 (run python scripts/trim_content.py). Which set is served is controlled by content_version below.
_notes.posters: Posters use Internet Archive thumbnail service or Google sample-images bucket; tile gradients fall back if a poster 404s.
_notes.content_duration: Full clips are trimmed to 15 minutes (900 s) at download time. The served short versions are exactly 8 minutes (480 s), generated by scripts/trim_content.py into static/content_short/; every active clip hits the cap, so all are identical in length and the forced mid-roll falls at 240 s for every participant. Switch sets with content_version below. catalog duration_sec reflects the served (short) length.
_notes.viewer_profile_categories: 4 profiles drive ad relevance. Each title's relevant_ad_category matches one profile. Within the arm pool the player keeps the best-fitting ads for the relevant arm and the worst-fitting for the irrelevant arm, scoring tag overlap as the overlap coefficient over context_tags. Only the synthetic_v3 ad set is live.

genre_to_ad_category.thrill_seeker: Action, horror, sports, adventure — relevant ads: THUNDERDROP (rollercoaster park), ADRENALINE (energy drink), APEX (running shoes), RANGER (climbing gear)

_notes.prolific_completion_url: Paste the completion URL from Prolific (Study → Completion paths, e.g. https://app.prolific.com/submissions/complete?cc=XXXXXXX) into prolific_completion_url before launch. While it is empty the final screen tells participants to close the tab; once set, it shows a 'Last step: return to Prolific' link instead.

_conditions_notes: Each session is assigned one of four ad conditions (A0–A3) per the pre-registered protocol. `condition_assignment_mode` controls how conditions are picked: 'fixed' uses `active_condition` for every session (use for development); 'random' picks uniformly from `random_pool` on session start. The query parameter ?cond=A2 overrides for testing and is logged so the experimenter can spot accidental overrides. The chosen condition's `ads` array is exposed to the client at cfg.ads, and the player schedules each placement (preroll, midroll, postroll, overlay, user_initiated, user_choice) declaratively. Mid-roll/overlay start times can use `start_at_frac` (fraction of content duration, 0.0–1.0) and `start_at_cap_sec` (absolute cap so very long clips still get a mid-roll relatively early); the smaller resolved value wins. `duration_target_sec` hard-caps an ad's playback length so the 15-second spec is enforced regardless of the underlying asset length. The `user_choice` placement (A3) presents a three-button gate before playback; the chosen timing is re-dispatched to the existing preroll/midroll/postroll scheduling. `midroll_start_at_frac` sets where the midroll fires if midroll is chosen.

A0.label: Post-roll (control)
A0.description: A 15-second non-skippable ad plays after the clip ends, without interrupting playback. Baseline for both interruption-cost and agency-benefit comparisons.

A1.label: Forced pre-roll
A1.description: A 15-second non-skippable ad plays before the video begins. Playback is blocked until the ad completes. Goal interruption is shallow — the viewer has not yet initiated the content-consumption goal.

A2.label: Forced mid-roll
A2.description: A 15-second non-skippable ad interrupts playback at the midpoint of the clip. Goal interruption is deep — the viewer's ongoing narrative comprehension is halted at peak engagement.

A3.label: Viewer-chosen timing
A3.description: The viewer is told they will see one 15s ad and chooses when it plays: before, in the middle, or after the clip. Playback is gated on the choice; every participant sees exactly one ad.

conditions._exp2_notes: Experiment 2 — 3×2 between-subjects (Explanation type E0/E1/E2 × Placement P1/P2). P1=forced mid-roll (high intrusiveness); P2=user-initiated (low intrusiveness). Ad relevance is fixed to relevant, so creatives come from the same library and selection rule as Exp 1. The explanation banners are switched off (show: false) until Exp 2 runs. The 'banner' field carries the explanation text rendered as 'Why this ad?' below the ad during playback.

B0.label: Exp2: No explanation, Mid-roll
B0.description: Forced mid-roll, no ad explanation (E0×P1). Control cell for Experiment 2.

B1.label: Exp2: Content-based explanation, Mid-roll
B1.description: Forced mid-roll with content-based explanation (E1×P1). Banner reads 'Why this ad? This ad was selected based on what you watch on this platform.'

B2.description: Forced mid-roll with data-based explanation (E2×P1). Banner reads 'Why this ad? This ad was selected based on your browsing history and demographic profile.'
